name: codecooksage-ai
description: AI-powered code reviews inside VS Code. Get instant, expert-level feedback on bugs, security, performance, and code quality — powered by DeepSeek.

enumDescriptions: OpenRouter — hosted gateway across many providers
OmniRoute — self-hosted gateway; set baseUrl to your instance
Custom — any other OpenAI-compatible endpoint; set baseUrl
codesage-ai.provider.description: Provider preset. Every option must expose an OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions endpoint.

codesage-ai.baseUrl.description: API base URL, for example http://localhost:8080/v1. Leave empty to use the provider preset's default. Required for the omniroute and custom presets.

codesage-ai.model.description: Model identifier to request. Must be a model your configured provider actually serves.

codesage-ai.maxTokens.description: Maximum tokens in the AI response.

codesage-ai.temperature.description: Controls response creativity. Lower = more focused, higher = more creative.

enumDescriptions: General -- Balanced review covering bugs, security, performance, and readability
Security -- Focused security audit: vulnerabilities, OWASP, secrets, injection
Performance -- Performance analysis: complexity, bottlenecks, memory, I/O
Clean Code -- Readability, SOLID, naming, refactoring
codesage-ai.reviewProfile.description: Review profile that tailors the AI's review focus.

codesage-ai.enableCodeLens.description: Show 'Review' buttons above functions, methods, and classes.

codesage-ai.enableStreaming.description: Stream review results in real-time as the AI generates them.
